newsitem.title: POLAND: ZLOTY EASES VS BASKET ON DLR POSITION REBUILDING.
newsitem.headline: ZLOTY EASES VS BASKET ON DLR POSITION REBUILDING.

text.p: The Polish zloty eased slightly by 0.1 percent against the currency basket in early trade after opening a touch higher as Polish banks rebuilt their currency positions after shortening them on Tuesday, dealers said.
They said banks sold currencies yesterday ahead of the long weekend to take advantage of the higher interest on the zloty and were now returning to more balanced positions.

"The currency-buying sentiment will most likely push the zloty a bit down to a strong support at around -1.1 to 1.3 percent weaker than parity today," said Jaroslaw Dryjski, forex dealer at Bank Slaski SA.

At 0940 GMT the zloty was 0.95/1.00 weaker than the trading band centre against opening's -0.64/-0.92. It was at 3.4965/90 to the dollar and 1.8860/80 to the mark against opening's 3.4850/950 and 1.8800/50 respectively.
Some dealers said that before touching support at -1.3 percent from parity the zloty may stage a short rally on speculative purchases.

They said foreign investors were absent today after some of them sold the zloty on Tuesday, possibly expecting it to weaken further in the near-term despite the central bank's remarks it may further tighten its monetray policy.
Overnight rates were flat at 23.00/23.25 percent against 23.00/23.20 percent on Tuesday. T/N traded at 23.00/23.30 pct vs 23.15/23.25 percent.

Dealers said there were few transactions on the market as traders were still searching for a rate equilibrium after the central bank's Tuesday reverse repo tenders at which it raised the 14-day benchmark rate by 0.55 point to 23.55 percent.
On Wednesday the central bank again offered to drain one billion zlotys through a 14-day reverse repo and one billion zlotys through a 91-day NBP-bill auction.
